title: Display Over Other Apps (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
content:
QuickDash requires the SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission to display floating tools over other Android applications.

How to enable:
1. Open QuickDash and tap 'Grant Overlay Permission'.
2. Locate QuickDash in the system list and toggle 'Allow display over other apps'.
3. Return to QuickDash to start using floating bubble tools.

title: Adding Quick Settings Tiles (Android 13+)
content:
QuickDash provides two Quick Settings tiles:
- QuickDash Hub: Launches the main floating dashboard menu.
- Scan QR Code: Directly opens your preferred UPI payment app scanner.

To add tiles:
1. Swipe down twice from the top of your screen to open Quick Settings.
2. Tap the Edit (pencil) icon.
3. Drag 'QuickDash Hub' or 'Scan QR Code' into your active tile list.

title: Quick Collect (UPI & Payment QR Generator)
content:
Generate custom payment QR codes instantly on-screen.
- Supports any valid VPA / UPI ID (e.g. name@upi, number@paytm).
- Custom styling: Dot shapes, color gradients, and optional payment note.
- Direct launch buttons for GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, and BHIM.

title: Quick Translator & Screen Reader
content:
Translate text on-screen instantly using the floating translation tool.
- Auto-detect source text with manual paste support.
- Instant 1-tap translation to your target language.
- Direct link to Google Translate app for full-page translations.
